note: PSoXide Demo Disc v0.44-test, public pressing: the v0.43 public inputs unchanged (every program is the v0.43 build), with the launcher on XA menu music (Mulula VGM Loops, CC BY 4.0). Public pressing only: Half-Life, Hollow Knight, WipEout, Counter-Strike and the hardware tests are never on it. The `local` fields name checkouts on the build machine that hold each revision. Hashes gate every input; disc-tools lineup refuses a file that changed. The Arcade input is the build from main with the analog-required launcher (code equal to e8aec23, the image the v0.43 pressing carried), because the v0.43 image file itself no longer exists on this machine; its bin hash differs, its code does not.
